meta_description: Media economics are attention economics: commissioning, scheduling, promotion and rights all price against predicted engagement.

blocks.x: Media economics are attention economics: commissioning, scheduling, promotion and rights all price against predicted engagement. Studios and broadcasters that industrialize audience intelligence and content-operations automation compound catalog value instead of renting it.

The workflows we industrialize here: Commissioning and audience analysis, Content localization/ops, Rights/royalty accounting, Ad trafficking, Content security. Each arrives with its current cycle times measured in the Diagnose phase, and each leaves the program governed by outcome SLOs rather than anecdotes.

items: Linear, streaming, social and box-office data siloed; commissioning decisions anecdotal.
Localization, metadata, trailers and compliance edits consume weeks per title.
Embanked titles leak with catastrophic value loss; supply-chain security thin.
Royalty/rights accounting bilateral; disputes take quarters.
Campaign trafficking and reconciliation by spreadsheet; makegoods costly.
